title: First jets of an immersive linear system at its source
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, X a scheme locally of finite type over k, U0 an open of X, L an invertible module, V a k-vector space with finite basis b, and psi:V -> Gamma(X,L) k-linear. Assume its basis sections generate L on U0 and their associated projective morphism is an immersion [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]. Let x be a closed point of U0. On any open U containing x, let e be a free generator of L [def-sc-local-free-generator]. For every a in O_{X,x}, there is v in V whose coefficient relative to e has germ congruent to a modulo m_x^2. Thus the local coefficient map realizes every first jet at x. Invertibility, generation and schemes use [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] and [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There is no etale map or dimension assumption.

proof.text: Construct the k-algebra structure on R=O_(X,x) by taking germs of the base scalars. Restriction, the free-generator coefficient map, and the germ map turn ψ into a k-linear map f:V→R. The displayed hlinear equation gives scalar compatibility after the germ-restriction identity. The residue-field structure map agrees with the residue of this scalar map by the scheme stalk-map identities.

The residue field at the closed point x is finite over k, already under the local finite-type assumption. Algebraic closedness makes its structure map from k surjective. Thus for every a∈R there is c∈k with a-ρ(c)∈m. This is proved directly using finite_residueField_of_isClosed and IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral, without a quasi-compactness assumption.
Apply the local-fraction presentation to the basis-section family s_j=ψ(b_j). It gives an index i, a unit u=f(b_i), and polynomial-fraction presentations of every element of R in u⁻¹f(b_j).

The private Lean theorem linear_image_firstOrder completes the algebraic argument. Put g=u⁻¹f, J=m² and M=range(g)+J as k-submodules of R. Then 1∈M. If a,b∈M, choose residues c,d∈k. The product (a-ρ(c))(b-ρ(d)) is in J; expanding it shows ab∈M. If z is a unit in M, choose residues c,d of z,z⁻¹. The first is nonzero because z is a unit. Expanding (z-ρ(c))(z⁻¹-ρ(d))∈J expresses c z⁻¹ as a linear combination of 1 and z plus an element of J, so z⁻¹∈M. Polynomial induction puts each evaluated polynomial in M, and the fraction presentations then give M=R. Apply this to u⁻¹a, obtain g(v)-u⁻¹a∈J, and multiply by u to get f(v)-a∈m². This is the requested coefficient in the original frame; every step is implemented without sorry.

Thirteen hits: Ideal.mapCotangent and its surjectivity lemmas, completion and smooth quotient applications. No homOfGeneratingSections or first-jet theorem. theorem immersiveSystem_source_first_jets
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (U₀ : X.Opens)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k V) (ψ : V →+ Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hlinear : ∀ (c : k) (v : V),
      ψ (c • v) = (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv c) • ψ v)
    (hgen : Epi (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L).freeHomEquiv.symm
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection _
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (b i.down)))))))
    [IsImmersion (@ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections
      (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) inferInstance U₀.toScheme (Spec (.of k))
      (U₀.ι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L)
      (Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.of_iso
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction U₀.ι)).leftAdjointUniq
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U₀.ι)).app L).symm)
      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection _
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (b i.down))))) hgen)]
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hxU₀ : x ∈ U₀)
    (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) (e : Γ(L, U))
    (he : Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator e) :
    ∀ a : X.presheaf.stalk x, ∃ v : V,
      X.presheaf.germ U x hxU
          (he.coeff (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (ψ v))) - a ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ^ 2
